ExponentialLR decay to 5% (up from 2%) to preserve gradient signal late in training
lr=4e-4 (up from 3e-4) to raise resumed effective LR and escape combined-mean plateau
focal loss gamma=2.0 to focus gradient on hard piece predictions and reduce empty-square coasting
revert focal loss and lr=4e-4 to standard CE and lr=3e-4 to remove two sequential regressions
revert beta2 from 0.99 to 0.999 to restore stable second-moment estimates after regression
ExponentialLR end-LR from 5% back to 2% to tighten late-stage convergence and reduce plateau oscillation
label smoothing eps=0.1 to reduce overconfidence on easy empty-square predictions and improve chessred2k generalization
batch_size=32 (up from 24) to reduce gradient noise and improve convergence from combined-mean plateau
ResNet-34 backbone + 2-layer MLP head to break combined-mean plateau with more model capacity
raise input resolution from 256 to 320 so each cell gets 40x40 pixels, adaptive_avg_pool to 8x8 preserves head shape — targets chessred2k small-piece-at-angle error
add a single transformer encoder layer with learned positional embedding over the 64 cells before the 1x1 head, so neighbors can disambiguate piece overlap and angled-view ambiguity
focal cross-entropy (gamma=2) replaces plain CE so easy empty cells stop dominating the gradient — push capacity to hard piece cells driving chessred2k angled-view error
richer 2-layer head (Conv2d(512,256,1)->GELU->Conv2d(256,13,1)) after the cell-attention block, giving each cell more nonlinear classification capacity on top of the context-aggregated features
add Sobel edge-magnitude as 4th input channel to give the backbone explicit piece-silhouette signal — targets chessred2k angled-view piece/empty ambiguity
stack cell-attention transformer to 2 layers (from 1) so longer-range cross-cell context can resolve angled-piece ambiguity that single-hop neighbor exchange leaves on the table

add factorized auxiliary losses by marginalizing 13-class logits into a 3-class color (black/empty/white) and 7-class piece-type (empty/b/k/n/p/q/r) softmax via logsumexp, with weight 0.3 each, so the model gets explicit gradient signal on color and shape confusions independently — targets chessred2k angled-view errors where light/dark and silhouette ambiguity are largely orthogonal

swap backbone from ResNet-18 to ResNet-34 (same 512-dim 8x8 layer4 output, so cell-attn transformer/head/pos-embed load unchanged from resume) — adds depth capacity targeting chessred2k angled-view piece confusions where the architecture has been frozen at the smallest variant for all 13 prior iterations

raise input resolution from 256 to 320 (warp 320x320, ResNet-34 layer4 -> 10x10, existing adaptive_avg_pool2d to 8x8 keeps cell_pos_embed/transformer/head shape-compatible) so each cell sees ~1.56x more pixels — targets chessred2k angled-view piece confusions where small/distant pieces are sub-pixel-detail-limited

add directional illumination-gradient augmentation (random-angle multiplicative ramp, ~+/-25% across the board, p=0.6) to simulate the uneven room lighting in chessred2k angled phone photos that the evenly-lit recovered/synthetic training data lacks — targets the chessred2k:val plateau driven by domain mismatch in lighting non-uniformity rather than architecture capacity

add board-aware positional channels (cell_row, cell_col, square_color in [-1,1]) concatenated with RGB as 6-channel input, with conv1 expanded by zero-init for the new channels so ImageNet-tuned RGB filters are preserved — gives the conv backbone explicit per-pixel cell-grid signal so it can localize cell boundaries even when the upstream warp slips by a few pixels and so square color (light/dark) is a free input rather than something the model must infer from texture, targeting the chessred2k angled-view plateau where pieces overlap cell boundaries and visual square color cues are unreliable

add FPN-style lateral fusion from layer3 (256ch, 16x16 avg-pooled to 8x8) into layer4 (512ch, 8x8) via a zero-initialized 1x1 conv before the cell-attention transformer, so the per-cell features carry finer-grained piece-silhouette detail from a stage where the spatial map has not yet been averaged to 8x8 — targets chessred2k angled-view confusions on small/boundary-overlapping pieces where layer4's coarse map blurs the discriminative edges; zero-init keeps the resume checkpoint a no-op fine-tune

upgrade backbone from ResNet-34 to ResNet-50 with a 1x1 channel reducer (2048->512) preserving d_model=512 so the cell-attention transformer / cell_pos_embed / head all load shape-compatible from the resume checkpoint, and updating the FPN lateral_l3 to accept R50's 1024ch layer3 (still zero-init) — targets chessred2k angled-piece confusions where the prior R18->R34 jump (current best) showed the architecture was capacity-limited and R50's deeper Bottleneck stack adds the next tier of feature-extraction depth without breaking the rest of the pipeline

add JPEG re-encoding augmentation (random quality 30-85, p=0.5) to simulate the lossy 8x8-block / chroma-subsampling artifacts present in chessred2k phone-camera photos but absent from the cleanly-rendered recovered/synthetic training images — extends the same source-domain-match line as the recently-promoted illumination-gradient aug, targeting the chessred2k:val plateau driven by photographic-pipeline mismatch rather than model capacity (which the R50 and 320-input attempts showed has diminishing returns at this budget)

sharpen FPN layer3 lateral by replacing avg-pool+1x1 conv with a learned 3x3 stride-2 conv that downsamples layer3's 16x16 directly to 8x8 (zero-init preserved so resume is a no-op fine-tune), so the per-cell features carry crisper piece-silhouette edges instead of 2x2-averaged ones — extends the current-best FPN-fusion line, targeting the chessred2k angled-view plateau where small/boundary-overlapping pieces lose discriminative edge structure under avg-pool

extend the current-best FPN lateral fusion by adding a second zero-initialized 1x1 lateral from layer2 (128ch, 32x32 avg-pooled to 8x8) into the layer4 8x8 sum, on top of the existing layer3 lateral, so per-cell features carry edge/texture detail from a stage two levels finer than layer3 — targets chessred2k angled-view confusions on thin/small pieces (knight ear cutouts, pawn vs bishop tops) where even layer3's 16x16 map has already smoothed away the discriminative silhouette edges; zero-init keeps the resume checkpoint a no-op fine-tune

add dropout regularization (p=0.1) inside the cell-attention transformer encoder layers and a Dropout2d(p=0.1) on the per-cell feature map immediately before the 2-layer classification head, targeting the ~4.5x recovered:val (0.010) vs chessred2k:val (0.046) generalization gap which is classic overfit-to-clean-train-domain rather than capacity (R50 and 320-input attempts confirmed capacity is not the bottleneck) — both dropouts are parameter-free additions so checkpoint keys/shapes are preserved and resume is exact, the dropout simply turns on during fine-tuning to inject stochasticity into the cross-cell mixing and per-cell readout where the chessred2k errors are concentrated

add label smoothing (eps=0.1) to focal cross-entropy loss — mixes hard-label NLL with uniform NLL so the model is penalized for overconfident predictions on easy clean-domain cells, targeting the 4.5x domain gap (recovered:val 0.010 vs chessred2k:val 0.046) as a target-parameterization regularizer; no parameter shape changes so checkpoint resume is exact

reduce focal gamma from 2.0 to 1.5 to rebalance gradient signal when combined with label smoothing (eps=0.1): gamma=2 over-suppresses easy-sample gradients when label smoothing is already active, reducing to 1.5 preserves harder-sample focus while allowing more gradient from moderately-confident cells, targeting chessred2k generalization where piece discrimination is moderately difficult rather than strictly hard
increase AUX_FACTOR_LOSS_WEIGHT 0.3->0.5 and restore FOCAL_GAMMA=2.0: stronger auxiliary color/type factorization to improve domain-invariant representations for chessred2k generalization

relax ExponentialLR final-LR target from 2% to 5% to sustain gradient signal late in training for harder chessred2k cells; restore AUX_FACTOR_LOSS_WEIGHT to 0.3 (best known, undoing the discarded 0.5 increase)
reduce batch_size 32->16 for higher-variance gradient updates as implicit domain regularization; restore ExponentialLR decay to 2% final LR (best known, reverting discarded 5%)
